meta.title: Kiln — studio credentials 2026
meta.description: Credentials for Kiln, a Porto ceramics studio that makes tableware for restaurants and hotels: point of view, three measured cases, clients and a 16-week process.

slides.heading: We make the plates a restaurant is remembered by.
slides.lead: Tableware for chefs and hotels, thrown and fired in Porto since 2019.
slides.notes: Say the line, then move straight to the work. This deck is image-first.

slides.heading: A plate is part of the dish, so we start in the kitchen
slides.lead: Every commission begins with a week of service beside the chef.

slides.heading: A thicker rim cut Fennel & Ash's breakage from 11% to 2%
slides.lead: 2,400 pieces for a 90-cover tasting room. We rebuilt the rim after a week on the pass.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 -50 1600 400'><rect y='-50' width='1600' height='450' fill='%23232E26'/><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' fill='%23F0E8D2'><text x='560' y='70' font-size='26'>OLD RIM · 3 mm · chipped</text><path d='M560 160 Q760 180 880 130 L884 138 Q760 192 560 170 Z' fill='%23b8b4a4'/><path d='M866 124 l18 10 l-6 8 z' fill='%23E06A2A'/><text x='930' y='70' font-size='26' fill='%23E08A40'>KILN · 5.5 mm rolled</text><path d='M930 160 Q1100 180 1180 128 Q1206 116 1204 138 Q1200 156 1180 154 Q1100 200 930 182 Z' fill='%23C07030'/></g><g fill='%23EDE6D0' stroke='%23232E26' stroke-width='4'><rect x='1220' y='250' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/><rect x='1220' y='220' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/><rect x='1220' y='190' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/><rect x='1220' y='160' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/><rect x='1220' y='130' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/><rect x='1220' y='100' width='280' height='26' rx='13'/></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Cross-section of two plate rims: the old 3 mm rim chips at the pass; the Kiln 5.5 mm rolled rim does not. Beside them, a stack of plates.
slides.notes: Tell the story in one breath: a week on the pass, we saw plates chip in the stack, we rebuilt the rim.

slides.heading: Fennel & Ash now spends €12,200 less a year on replacements

stats.label: pieces broken per year in 2025, down from 11%

slides.heading: For Hotel Alma we made a sage glaze that hides cutlery marks
slides.body:
1,600 pieces for 220 breakfasts a day.
The glaze was tested against 400 knife strokes.

slides.heading: 93% of Hotel Alma's breakfast set is still in service after three years
slides.label: pieces in service, 2023–2026
slides.lead: Their previous supplier's set: 58% after three years. Source: Hotel Alma inventory counts.

slides.heading: Miso Bar's ramen bowl sold 1,800 copies in its shop in one year
slides.lead: We matched the glaze to the broth. Guests asked to take the bowl home.

slides.quote: Kiln spent a week on our pass before they drew a single plate. Nobody else asked.

slides.heading: A commission takes 16 weeks from first service to last firing
slides.notes: Stress week 1. It is why the results on the case slides happened.

slides.heading: Let's make the plates your guests will remember
slides.lead: Start with a week in your kitchen. Studio visits Thursday to Sunday.
